data.long_meaning: The name 'Kantilal' is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Kanti' meaning 'ear' and 'Lal' meaning 'God'. This name signifies the one who is very dear to God and is often mentioned in Hindu scriptures. The name Kantilal carries the meaning “God's ear” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Kantilal usually hope their child will grow to embody god's ear and live with faith, good character and purpose.
